lines.speaker: sol
lines.text: Hey, stranger. I was about to invite you to a wildly complicated adventure.

lines.speaker: Protagonist
lines.text: And what did you come up with?

lines.speaker: sol
lines.text: Nothing. Not a scavenger hunt. Not a surprise. I just wondered if you would sit with me.

lines.speaker: sol
lines.text: The last party taught me something: being with someone does not need a program. So... no rules today?

choices.label: We could watch the harbor for a while.
choices.reply: That sounds weirdly perfect. I will try not to turn the clouds into a contest.

choices.label: I cannot today. Thanks for asking.
choices.reply: An honest no. I can handle that. There will be other sunsets.
